Sandbox_TrueCigsBrands: True Cigarettes: spawn rate per brand
Sandbox_TrueCigs_BrandExtras_tooltip: Extra per-brand stat changes on top of the item stats. Off = every brand behaves like its item script only.
Sandbox_TrueCigs_EffectScale_tooltip: Multiplies the extra per-brand stat changes. 1.0 = as designed.
Sandbox_TrueCigs_TrueSmokingIntegration_: Register brand cigarettes with the True Smoking mod (brand strength, length, extras). Off = True Smoking treats them as generic cigarettes.
Sandbox_TrueCigs_LootRate_tooltip: Multiplies how often brand packs, cartons and cigarettes spawn. 1.0 = as designed, 0 = none. Applies to containers generated after the world loads. Each brand has its own rate on the next page, which is multiplied with this one.
Sandbox_TrueCigs_Rate_Marlboro_tooltip: How often Marlboro packs, cartons and cigarettes spawn. 1.0 = as designed, 0 = never, 2.0 = twice as often. Multiplied with the all-brands rate. Applies to containers generated after the world loads.
